name: Quipper (Quipper School / Quipper School Premium / Quipper Campus; formerly Quipper Video)
origin_region: Founded in London, UK (2010) by Masayuki Watanabe; acquired 100% by Japan's Recruit Holdings for USD 39M in 2015. Operates in Japan (as Study Sapuri), Indonesia, Philippines and Mexico. Indonesian entity is PT Quipper Edukasi Indonesia (Jakarta), which became a direct subsidiary rather than a Recruit joint venture on 1 October 2021. The Philippine site now states 'Quipper is part of the Manabie Group, an EdTech company founded in Singapore' — Manabie was founded by Quipper co-founder Takuya Homma; whether this ownership change also covers the Indonesian entity is not confirmed on Indonesian channels [uncertain]
target_age: Indonesia: junior and senior secondary only — SMP and SMA/SMK, roughly grades 7-12 (ages ~12-18). The discontinued Quipper Video explicitly served 'siswa dari jenjang SMP sampai SMA'. All partner schools listed on the Quipper School Premium page are SMA/SMAS/MAN (senior high). There is NO dedicated elementary-school (SD, grades 1-6) mathematics product in Indonesia [uncertain — no explicit vendor statement excluding SD, inferred from client list and product copy]. By contrast, Quipper Philippines advertises coverage 'from Kinder to Tertiary'
delivery_mode: online-app, now predominantly B2B school SaaS. Quipper School / Quipper School Premium is a web-and-mobile LMS sold to schools (teacher portal + student portal), supporting hybrid learning. The direct-to-consumer video subscription (Quipper Video, incl. Quipper Video Masterclass live tutor chat) was shut down in Indonesia on 1 July 2024, so the remaining Indonesian offer reaches children only through their school, not as a standalone parent-purchased app
language_localization: Full native Bahasa Indonesia — UI, teaching materials, question bank, teacher training modules, blog and customer support are all in Indonesian, produced by a local Jakarta team. Content is locally developed per market rather than translated. Parent-facing Indonesian-language reporting does not exist as a product surface (see how_parent_involved)
pricing_model: B2B subscription, price not published — the Quipper School Premium page requires a demo booking form: 'Silakan isi formulir Buat Janji Demo untuk mendapatkan penjelasan lengkap seputar paket dan harga'. A free tier of the basic Quipper School LMS has historically been available to teachers. The former B2C consumer subscription (Quipper Video) was discontinued on 1 July 2024 with pro-rata refunds for subscriptions running to 30 June 2025
local_curriculum_alignment: Strong and explicit. Quipper School Premium states it supports Kurikulum Merdeka, including translation of Capaian Pembelajaran (CP) into Alur Tujuan Pembelajaran (ATP), ready-made Projek Penguatan Profil Pelajar Pancasila (P5) modules, and practice items supporting AKM literacy and numeracy assessment, plus UTBK SNBT university-entrance preparation. This is one of the deepest local-curriculum alignments among the competitor set — but it is aligned to secondary-school curriculum, not primary mathematics
does_error_type_diagnosis: no. Quipper's diagnosis stops at score and topic level. Its 'Tes Diagnostik' is an initial/placement assessment used by schools to 'mengukur assessment awal dari siswa', and its tryout reports carry 'analisis kelemahan' (weakness analysis) expressed as which topics or competencies a student is weak in, plus cognitive and affective learner profiling. There is no evidence anywhere in Quipper's Indonesian product copy, teacher documentation or announcements of a taxonomy that classifies WHY an answer was wrong (e.g. misreading the problem vs. holding a wrong concept vs. an arithmetic slip). Reports are downloadable as .xlsx score recaps for teachers to interpret themselves, which pushes the error-type inference onto the human teacher
diagnosis_granularity: topic-mastery-map — between score-only and true misconception mapping. Outputs are: (a) numeric grade reports (Laporan Nilai) and answer recapitulations exportable to .xlsx; (b) a student learning profile combining cognitive and affective aspects; (c) tryout reports with topic-level weakness analysis and a probability-style readiness estimate for university admission. No distractor-level misconception mapping is documented, and no error-type taxonomy exists
diagnosis_input_modality: mcq-distractor / auto-graded closed-form items. The Quipper Assessment (Tes Penilaian) workflow is: teacher assigns test to students, students complete within a time window, teacher reads results in Laporan Nilai — a machine-scorable item flow. There is no free-response OCR, no handwriting or stroke capture, and no student self-report of the reasoning step where they got stuck. The Philippine 'AI Tutor' (COMING SOON) does accept a photo, but of the PROBLEM to be explained ('Students take a picture of any problem and receive clear, step-by-step explanations'), not of the child's own written attempt — so even that feature reads the question, not the mistake
ai_tutor_diagnosis_reliability: Not applicable / unvalidated. There is no shipped AI diagnosis engine in Indonesia to validate. The Quipper AI Tutor announced on the Philippine site is explicitly labelled 'COMING SOON · Powered by Manabie AI' as of this research (August 2026), so no accuracy figures, ground-truth comparison, or documented failure modes exist publicly. Its described design — a generative-AI explainer that adapts hints 'based on each learner's level of understanding' from a photo of the problem — is architecturally exposed to the classic 'correct answer trap' failure mode: because it never ingests the student's own working, it cannot distinguish a child who reached the right answer by sound reasoning from one who guessed, nor tell a place-value misconception from a transcription slip. Quipper publishes no reliability or validation study for any diagnostic claim [uncertain — absence of published evidence, not a documented failure]
evidence_quote: From the Quipper School Premium page (quipper.com/id/school/premium): '20x Online Tryout yang dilengkapi laporan perkembangan siswa beserta analisis kelemahannya untuk intervensi yang lebih akurat' ('20x online tryouts equipped with student progress reports plus weakness analysis for more accurate intervention') and 'Laporan Hasil Belajar Terintegrasi — Susun profil belajar siswa yang berisi aspek kognitif dan afektif, serta analisis proses dan hasil belajar siswa' ('Integrated learning outcome reports — build a student learning profile covering cognitive and affective aspects, plus analysis of the student's learning process and results'). A school principal testimonial on the same page: 'Sekolah sangat terbantu dengan fitur Tes Diagnostik dari QSP. Melalui Tes Diagnostik, Quipper membantu kami dari pihak sekolah dalam mengukur assessment awal dari siswa kami' ('The school is greatly helped by QSP's Diagnostic Test feature. Through the Diagnostic Test, Quipper helps us as the school measure our students' initial assessment'). Note that 'kelemahan' (weakness) here is consistently topic/competency weakness, never a named error type. On the teacher workflow: 'Guru menugaskan Tes Penilaian ke siswa > Siswa menyelesaikan tes sesuai waktu yang ditentukan > Guru melihat hasil kerja di Laporan Nilai'
how_parent_involved: Indonesia: essentially none / passive, mediated entirely by the school. The Quipper Indonesia login page offers only two account types — 'Untuk Guru' (Portal Guru) and 'Untuk Siswa' (Portal Siswa). There is no parent portal, no parent login, and no parent app in the Indonesian product. Community and blog guidance describes parents as collaborating with the homeroom teacher to discuss the child's progress — i.e. the parent receives information second-hand through a teacher meeting, not through the platform. This is a structurally different posture from Quipper Philippines, which explicitly ships a 'Parents' Portal' within the Quipper LMS and markets 'For Parents — Real visibility into progress. Deeper family involvement, with real-time visibility into their child's learning journey — right at parents' fingertips'. Since the B2C Quipper Video shutdown in July 2024, the Indonesian parent is also no longer even the paying customer — the school is
ai_tutor_directly_to_child: no in Indonesia (as of August 2026); planned-but-unshipped in the Philippines. Quipper Indonesia's current live surface has no conversational AI aimed at students; the closest historical analogue was Quipper Video Masterclass, where a HUMAN coach/tutor chatted with students in-app to plan study time and answer unlimited questions — and that service died with Quipper Video on 1 July 2024. Quipper Philippines markets a forthcoming 'Quipper AI Tutor' that would talk directly to the student: 'Every student now deserves a personal tutor in their pocket. Using the latest generative AI, the AI Tutor answers questions in real time — generating optimal hints and step-by-step explanations based on each learner's level of understanding … Real-time, 24/7 support.' It is flagged 'COMING SOON' and there is no equivalent announcement for the Indonesian market
key_finding: Quipper is a large, deeply curriculum-localized Indonesian incumbent that is nevertheless absent from the exact gap being probed on all three axes. (1) Error-type diagnosis: no. Despite naming a feature 'Tes Diagnostik' and marketing 'analisis kelemahan', Quipper's diagnosis is a topic-mastery and score map generated from auto-scored MCQ-style items; nothing classifies the KIND of mistake, and the raw output is an .xlsx recap for a teacher to interpret. (2) Parents: no parent surface at all in Indonesia — only teacher and student portals — while the sister Philippine operation does ship a Parents' Portal, showing the omission is a market choice rather than a technical limit. (3) AI tutor to the child: none shipped in Indonesia; the Philippine AI Tutor is still 'COMING SOON', and by design it photographs the QUESTION rather than the child's own written work, so even when it ships it explains problems rather than diagnoses mistakes. Two structural facts sharpen the gap: Quipper retreated from direct-to-consumer in Indonesia entirely when it shut Quipper Video on 1 July 2024, leaving school-mediated B2B as its only route to a child — so a parent of a primary-school child cannot buy Quipper at all; and Quipper's Indonesian content and client base are secondary-school (SMP/SMA) with an SNBT university-entrance centre of gravity, leaving primary-school mathematics (SD, and specifically grades 1-4) unserved. The upshot: Indonesia's most curriculum-aligned LMS incumbent leaves the primary-math, error-type-diagnosis, parent-facing, direct-to-child niche completely open
study_scale_or_sample: Vendor-reported adoption figures, not research samples. Quipper Indonesia claims 6,000,000+ registered students and 400,000+ teachers joined. Quipper School Premium claims 177,000 teachers have used QSP, 120,000+ ready-to-use videos and practice items, and '8 of 10 teachers and principals satisfied with QSP services (odd semester 2022/2023)'. Quipper Philippines claims 344,000+ engaged students, 7,000+ teachers, 600+ partner schools, 3 Asian markets, 12 years in the Philippines. Quipper Video served 'ratusan ribu' (hundreds of thousands) of users between 2016 and its 2024 shutdown. Independent Indonesian academic literature on Quipper School exists but consists of small single-school studies (e.g. an SMP Negeri 2 Campalagian learning-outcomes study, and EFL-teacher/student perception studies), typically tens to a couple hundred participants
evidence_strength: moderate. Product claims come from Quipper's own official Indonesian and Philippine websites and official company announcements (the Quipper Video shutdown notice and the parent-company change notice are first-party, dated, and unambiguous), which is strong for what the product DOES offer. The core negative findings — no error-type taxonomy, no Indonesian parent portal, no shipped AI tutor in Indonesia — rest on the absence of any such claim across Quipper's own marketing, login flows and teacher documentation, which is reliable but is argument-from-silence rather than an explicit vendor denial. Grade-level exclusion of SD is inferred from client lists and product copy rather than stated
remediation_efficacy_evidence: None found. There is no RCT, quasi-experiment, or published efficacy study demonstrating that Quipper's diagnostic output causes improved learning outcomes. The vendor's efficacy language is entirely about teacher satisfaction, time saved on administration, and adoption counts, plus a marketing assertion that weakness analysis enables 'intervensi yang lebih akurat' (more accurate intervention) — an unmeasured claim. The independent Indonesian literature that does exist measures whether using Quipper School as a delivery platform correlates with better test scores in single schools, which speaks to platform use rather than to diagnostic validity, and none of it evaluates diagnosis-to-remediation causality. Sample sizes and designs in that literature are small and non-randomized
